about.text: Bubble milk tea is black tea with milk and sugar, served with chewy cooked tapioca pearls and sometimes pudding, nata de coco or grass jelly. The oldest known recipe uses hot black tea, tapioca balls, condensed milk and syrup or honey. Its origin is claimed by two Taiwanese teahouses from the 1980s.
